BL-1427 — The BL-1395 script load guard covers a fraction of what it claims and runs what it promised to guard: its while-read loop is drained by a script that reads stdin when loaded (--all analysed 107 of 286 scripts on 2026-09-05 and reported the other 178 as clean, an unreadable file among them), and its probe executes each script's top-level entry call, so a CLI with a fixed-arity -main is refused for an arity error it never has when run; the probe's stdin is closed, the pass line claims only the coverage it got, and an entry call is analysed but never run
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-05 by the specifier as the companion to BL-1426, after
tracing why the guard had not caught an unreadable script that had sat
on main for ten days. Numbers in the title and description are from that
trace (`bash -x ... --all`: 107 `analyse_one` calls, last
